notes.title: Custom Textures Update
notes.content:
This is a new feature, mostly aimed at advanced players who want to further customize their builds or who want to sell custom texture sets they made to other players.

Content WARNING
We understand that by providing more customization we open ourselves up to people spamming the game with things that are not family friendly. Do not do this. If we catch you, your accounts will be permanently banned. What kind of content should not be on custom textures?

adult content
controversial content
political / religious messaging
copyrighted material
etc...
Basically anything that's not kid friendly or aimed at general audiences. This does leave some gray area but I think most people can understand what falls under that umbrella.

How to create a set of custom textures
To create a custom texture you need 2 items (from cubit store)

easle block (used for painting textures)
master canvas (use with easle block)
Place the master canvas in the easle and use the paint tool to create your textures You can give the canvas a name. A master canvas can have up to 16 custom textures. A single realm can only display 1 set of custom textures at a time.

NOTE - When using a master canvas ONLY YOU can see the result on the custom blocks in the realm. You can't use a master canvas to share your textures.

How to share your custom textures with other players visiting your realm
To share a custom texture set you need...

a copier block (cubit store)
copy paper (cubit store)
A texture projector block (cubit store)
custom blocks 1 to 16 to build with - these can be crafted - see recipes page
Place the master canvas in the copier and it will ask you if you want to submit it for approval.

WARNING - Once a master canvas is submitted you can NO LONGER EDIT IT!

Once your canvas is approved you can put it in the copier along with copy paper, and make copies. The copies can be placed in a texture projector block and your textures will show up on the custom blocks in your realm. (or whoever's realm used the copy - if you gave one away or sold one)

Note that copies can also be sold to other players so they can also use your texture set.

notes.title: Yuletide Season Event 2021
notes.content:
Here's how the Yuletide event works this year.

1) There are red and green ornaments to collect
2) Depending which ornaments are collected MORE.. the price of trading them in will be LESS. So say more green ornaments are collected than red ones... in that case it'll cost 1/2 the number of green ornaments for a prize that it does the red.
3) The prizes are...
- Mini Grouch Pet (green)
- Mini Krampus Pet (red)
And can be redeemed from cubic santa at the end of the event after new years.

So how do you get these ornaments? Well that's a mystery. We will give one clue. There's an official Christmas overworld. Through there you can find the way.

One note about the event. If the winning side's ornaments are worth more that means they will get more pets BUT.. REMEMBER.. you must ALSO consider that it means the losing side's pet will be rarer! and thus possibly worth more in the future. Something to consider for your strategy collecting ornaments.

notes.title: Ice World Raceway (OFFICIAL EVENT) RESULTS!!!
notes.content:
[h1]The Cubic Castles Race League 2020 (OFFICIAL EVENT)[/h1]
Welcome to the first official cubic castles racing league!
Due to recent changes to the racing rules i have decided it is fair enough to bring this in as an official ongoing event.
Each month a new racing event will be announced, players will have a whole month to compete for the fastest times!
Prizes will be awarded each month for the quickest times and the times will be added to the ongoing leaderboards available to view on this forum post.
At the end of the year the top positions will win prizes!
[h1]Rules[/h1]
-Any players found using alt accounts to attempt to win multiple prizes will have all accounts banned from that months event, continuing to do so will have the player banned from the entire event.
- all times will be submitted to the finish bumper within the realm when your lap is complete
- Any players found cheating or attempting to cheat will be disqualified for the month
- Any time 2 seconds more than the next fastest time due to lag will not count.In some instances this margin will differ. For example if there is a time of 52.07 seconds but every other time is 53 seconds you could assume that a player hasn't managed to beat the next 20 people by a whole second and rule it as a lag time. As there is no fix for lagging at this time players are advised to stop the lap if experiencing a large amount of lag and waiting till it has subsided to continue. Not only does your lag time not count but the bumper will prevent you from setting a true time because you can't beat your "lag time" which will stop you from competing in the event.
- If a player does set a lag time submitting a screenshot of a "proper time" to me via DM on the forums will be accepted as long as it shows both the time and a time stamp using /time in game. Players who are deemed to have a lag time will be disqualified from the month if no screenshot is submitted by the end of the months race, this will be done on an honesty system you will not be prompted to submit a screenshot you will be expected to "own up" to your own lag times.
- The top 20 times per month will all be awarded points for the overall leaderboard.
- 1st - 20pts
2nd - 19pts
and so on down to 20th place.
- If two players receive the same time they will be given equal points
- Not a rule but important! Make sure to use a wand to hit the go bumper while in your car for faster times!
[h1]Prizes[/h1]
The 10 quickest times of each month will win 25,000 cubits
kestrels – 20pts
sams42 – 19pts
spartabos – 18 pts
prendon - 17pts
sandd - 16pts
-JZ- -15 pts
Player - 14pts
LukeKing – 13pts
GHRIMBIKE65 – 12pts
SUNSETGLOW - 11pts
sambo1p - 10pts
cubicpencil – 8pts
Jaisonho – 7 pts
*Lil Pumkin – 6pts
Jedee – 5 pts
Zhipin_ - 4pts
leejunhang1234 – 3pts
Sir.Sculpty – 2 pts
Mr.Lecirius - 1pts

I am sorry that the last race of the year was spoiled somewhat by this bug that made setting scores a little harder than usual. But overall i think the race league has been a lot of fun.
For those of you confused about the final results i have used the rule about posting lag time to determine the scores and removing any that have been effected by the glitch. (I also mentioned this in someones thread that brought up the issue)
In relation to this many of you did submit screenshots and videos of your real times to me as also stated in the rules so thank you for that!
Anyone who did not resubmit a time of course does not feature on the leader board.

notes.title: Summer Building Contest 2020 (OFFICIAL EVENT)
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to the brand new summer building event!
We have a massive scale building contest like we have never done before so it is all very exciting!
[h1]Theme[/h1]
The theme of the contest is summer vacation. This can be any destination or activity you might want to go do on holiday. Maybe its scuba diving or skiing or visiting a hot country and laying on the beach! It is up to you.
[h1]Rules[/h1]
- All builds must be built in a 99x99 realm or room it cannot be smaller
- All builds must have an info bumper showing a date of the 1st July or later anything built in an older realm or room is disqualified. Please put team names and what your build is in the bumper or on a sign if it does not fit
- All builds must have a warp food bumper with the food left in the official contest realm.
- There is no maximum team size for this build as it is a mega team build, but remember the more of you there are the less prize money you can win!
- No copying other peoples work or harassing other teams, players that can be proved doing so will be disqualified.
- You may not build on more than one team players caught doing so will be disqualified
[h1]Costing[/h1]
For those of you that want the maths to justify the costings and before anyone complains this is too expensive etc
warp food bumper from store - 1000c
info bumper from store -1250c
realm or room - 8308c (realm) or 4276c (room)
doing it with a realm - 10,558c
doing it with a room - 6,526c
old building contests cost 5k per person while newer ones were reduced to 1k per person
so if building with a room it is only 1,526c more than the old contests
with a team of 7 people this reduces the cost of entering to less than 1k per player
So it is a little more expensive to go with a realm if you wanted to choose that option but it is up to the players and you do not have to choose that option!
[h1]Prizes[/h1]
1st - 500k
2nd - 300k
3rd - 150k
4th - 75k
5th - 50k
[h1]Deadline[/h1]
The deadline for the contest is the 31st of July!

notes.title: Version 1.28 - Slam Jump / Bumpers / Dice / Prize Dispensers
notes.content:
[h1]Cubic Castles was updated to version 1.2.8[/h1]

In the new version...

[list]
  [*] Triple jump to slam down. This can activate Bumpers.
  [*] Bumper blocks. Slam them or knock them with your head or a wand.
  [*] Dice! Use these to play board games!
  [*] Hidey Bumpers. Play games where you hide your id. Or just hide!

notes.title: Version 1.2.7 - Easter Update
notes.content:
A new version of cubic castles was uploaded yesterday.

This version has Donation Tables and Mannequins added, as well as an Easter egg hunt. More content around the corner too.

[u]The Legend of BunnyZilla[/u]

Folklore holds that every year, just before Easter, mysterious colored eggs appear all through the land of the Qbees. No one knows who hides them, or why. Some Scholars of the Egg even believe they are placed by the Almighty Cube itself!

What is known is that the eggs, innocuous in themselves, are imbued with a strange energy known as the “bunny force.” If ignored, the eggs evaporate in a few days, dissipating the magic.

But, if they are collected in large quantities, the “bunny force”  builds to a cataclysmic crescendo, summoning the titanic and mythical BunnyZilla to the worlds of Cubic Castles!

Top Qbee academics estimate that it would take anywhere from 100,000 - 250,000 harvested eggs to call BunnyZilla forth from the void.

While no one can say for sure, it is said that to see BunnyZilla is a great omen of good luck, sure to bring riches to anyone fortunate enough to see him!

notes.content:

    [*]New feature to give items to other players safely

notes.title: Halloween Pack + Unlocked Camera!
notes.content:
It's trick-or-treat time, and Cubic Castles has a new treats for you! 

[h1]Unlocked Camera[/h1]
A fully unlocked camera!  It's still experimental and everything may not look perfect, but it removes the top-down restriction and you can see your realms in a whole new way!   [b]Make sure to enable it in the game settings under "tweaks"[b]

[h1]Halloween Pack[/h1]
Get ready to trick-or-treat with our new Halloween Pack!  It has candy, pumpkins, and some spooky replacement heads for your characters- even a dinosaur head! They go perfect in the new nighttime realms!

We have another update waiting in the wings, with lots of new clothing- stay tuned!  Also, please let us know how you like the experimental unlocked camera.  If it's a hit, we'll enhance it even more.

[b]Thanks for playing![/b]

notes.title: Cubic Castles Version 1.01 is here!
notes.content:
As some may have already noticed we updated Cubic Castles to version 1.01 yesterday.  Here are some highlights of the changes and additions we made to the game.

[h1]Player Vs. Player![/h1]
[list]
[*]Wands! We've added a number of magic wands and a player vs player realm setting. Players can buy or craft them and use them to play against each-other. 
[*]There are 4 kinds of wands presently : Shrink wands, harm wands. heal wands, and knock-back wands
[/list]
[h1]Security![/h1]
[list]
[*]Realms are lockable now. But beware, locking your realm causes it to decay to your inventory if you leave it.
[*]Chests and containers can no longer be opened by players without build permissions
[*]There is a reporting button you can use to report  bad players and realms
[*]All new rooms are defaulting to ONLY ME permissions
[/list]
[h1]And More![/h1]
[list]
[*]There is now a cash register block you can use to make "safe" trades
[*]A warp anchor block stops people from warping right to you or cheating in parkour maps
[*]A rating block you can place in your castle to let players give you a star rating
[*]New Skymap features let you sort realms by rating, or type of realm
[*]New Dark environment skin and lighting blocks
[*]New clothes and blocks
[/list]	

Also note that a few more minor updates are in the wings, and will probably drop over the next few weeks. 

[b]Thanks for playing![/b]
